title: RuneScape Dragon Wilds: Complete Fight Cave Guide (Fire Cape)
author: Primitive Nomad
description:
This is a complete guide and overview of the new Fight Cave that was introduced with Umbral Sands. I go over everything you need to know about this challenge, the best strategy, gear, supplies and how how you should approach this. This is more so an endurance challenge and the hardest challenge we have seen for Dragonwilds.
